title: 第七章 救人！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“叮！恭喜宿主，突破明劲中期，一拳具备五百公斤巨力！”

系统浮现，叶凡眼神一亮。

“明劲中期？之前系统说过，明劲是国术境界，而国术就是武术，那下一境界是什么？暗劲？然后是化劲？”

脑中划过念头，叶凡上大学时看过不少小说，知道国术，有大概印象。

“嗯，看来我得查一下了，毕竟我现在一点招式都不会，只凭望气术和蛮力打人，这太浪费。”

心中想着，叶凡拿出手机，打算查国术。

咕噜噜！

怪异声音传出，叶凡身体一晃。

“好饿…怎么这么饿！”

叶凡脸色一变，这饥饿感太强了，他脑袋都发晕。

“系统提醒！由于宿主之前消耗大量精神鉴宝，所以需要在五分钟内进食！”

“否则宿主将会休克！”

叶凡瞳孔一缩，冲到冰箱，拿出两块面包就啃。

快速啃光后，叶凡感觉好了一些，但饥饿感还没退去。

拉开门，叶凡冲到小区拉面馆，要了两碗拉面和二斤牛肉。

吃完这些，饥饿感终于消退，他长出一口气。

“呼…原来如此，这望气术也不是时刻都能用的，要是时刻用，就会大量消耗我体能，看来以后得注意。”

心中自语，叶凡起身结账，走出面馆。

初夏夜风吹来，叶凡感到一阵凉爽。

“嗯，去公园逛逛吧，公园花草多，灵气应该也多些。”

叶凡赶往公园。

公园离他出租屋有五公里，往常叶凡骑车得十分钟，这次步行，他只用了五分钟！

“这就是明劲中期的体能么！果然厉害，简直是超人了！”

叶凡心中兴奋，看向公园一座五米高假山。

他有种感觉，一发力，他就能跳上去！

落水声响起！

“哎呀！出事了！有孩子掉下去了！”

“救人！快救人！”

嘈杂声打断叶凡想法，他看向公园人工湖。

在他眼里，一个小女孩不停在湖中央挣扎，眼看就要没力气。

“我得救人！”

本能升起念头，叶凡身体一动，跳入河里。

哗啦啦水声响起，在叶凡双臂摆动下，人工湖掀起一阵大浪！

公园中人惊呼起来，叶凡没管这么多，一把抓住小女孩胳膊，游向岸边。

Page (1/3)

"Ding! Congratulations to the host, you have broken through the middle stage of Ming Jin, and one punch has a huge force of 500 kilograms!"

The system emerged, and Ye Fan's eyes lit up.

"Mid stage of Ming Jin? The system has said before that Ming Jin is the realm of national martial arts, and national martial arts is martial arts. So what is the next realm? Dark Jin? And then Hua Jin?"

Thoughts flashed through his mind. Ye Fan had read a lot of novels when he was in college. He knew Chinese martial arts and had a rough impression.

"Well, it seems that I have to check it out. After all, I don't know any moves now. I only rely on Qi-gazing and brute force to hit people. This is too wasteful."

Thinking in his mind, Ye Fan took out his mobile phone and planned to check the martial arts.

Gulu!

A strange sound came out, and Ye Fan's body shook.

"So hungry...Why are you so hungry!"

Mark's expression changed. The hunger was so strong that his head felt dizzy.

"System reminder! Since the host has consumed a lot of spiritual treasure before, it needs to eat within five minutes!"

"Otherwise the host will go into shock!"

Ye Fan's pupils shrank, he rushed to the refrigerator, took out two pieces of bread and ate them.

After eating it all quickly, Ye Fan felt better, but his hunger had not gone away.

Opening the door, Ye Fan rushed to the community ramen restaurant and ordered two bowls of ramen and two pounds of beef.

After eating these, his hunger finally subsided and he let out a sigh of relief.

"Huh...I see, this qi-gazing technique cannot be used all the time. If I use it all the time, it will consume a lot of my physical energy. It seems I need to pay attention to it in the future."

Thinking to himself, Ye Fan stood up to pay the bill and walked out of the noodle shop.

The early summer night wind blew, and Ye Fan felt a chill.

"Well, let's go to the park for a walk. There are many flowers and plants in the park, and there should be more spiritual energy."

Ye Fan rushed to the park.

The park is five kilometers away from his rental house. It usually takes Ye Fan ten minutes to ride a bike, but this time it only took him five minutes to walk!

"Is this the physical fitness of Ming Jin in the middle stage? It's really amazing, it's almost superhuman!"

Ye Fan was excited and looked at a five-meter-high rockery in the park.

He had a feeling that if he exerted his strength, he could jump up!

The sound of falling water sounded!

"Oops! Something happened! A child fell down!"

"Save people! Help people!"

The noise interrupted Ye Fan's thoughts, and he looked towards the artificial lake in the park.

In his eyes, a little girl kept struggling in the middle of the lake and was about to lose her strength.

"I have to save people!"

Instinctively, Ye Fan moved his body and jumped into the river.

The sound of rushing water sounded, and with the swing of Ye Fan's arms, the artificial lake set off a big wave!

People in the park exclaimed, but Ye Fan didn't care so much, grabbed the little girl's arm and swam to the shore.
